lines.trans: They searched for him for seven days. Our whole neighborhood.
Even the police with dogs searched.
And what happened to him?
He fell from the footbridge into the river.
And he hit his head against a stone.
Fishermen later found him on the riverbed.
At first they thought it was a large catfish.
And it was Uncle Nikita.
The crayfish were very fond of him down there.
What a nightmare! Why are you saying that?
There are children sitting here in the kitchen!
I am just recalling old stories.
Please, enough of such scary stories.
